Payments outage, four hours

Summary

Card payments failed for four hours after a certificate on the payment gateway expired. No money was lost; around twelve thousand payments were declined and retried.

Timeline

09:12The gateway certificate expired.
09:20Declines rose and the on-call engineer was paged.
13:05A renewed certificate was deployed and payments recovered.

Remediation

  • Alert thirty days before any certificate expires. Owner: platform team, by 1 March.
  • Renew certificates automatically. Owner: payments team, by 15 March.
